# The Collective Style Guide Library

> Enterprise- and SaaS-ready visual identities. Seven variants on one accessible foundation (IBM Carbon, Apache 2.0).

Each variant is a complete design system: tokens, principles, content/voice, motion, i18n stance, and a starter prompt for LLMs. Designed for direct use by Claude, Cursor, Figma, and other agents.

## Variants

- [Foundry](packages/foundry/llm/llms.txt) — Neo Bauhaus. Geometric sans, primary RYB palette, sharp corners, grid-forward.
- [Vellum](packages/vellum/llm/llms.txt) — International Style. Swiss grid, restrained palette, paper-cool clarity.
- [Beacon](packages/beacon/llm/llms.txt) — Schiphol wayfinding. Signage yellow, near-black ink, hierarchy as design.
- [Marginalia](packages/marginalia/llm/llms.txt) — Penguin Books. Cream paper, serif body, Penguin orange accent.
- [Proscenium](packages/proscenium/llm/llms.txt) — The Public Theater. Wood-type display, hot magenta + yellow.
- [Caesura](packages/caesura/llm/llms.txt) — Bringhurst. Classical book typography, oxblood accent, careful spacing.
- [Cipher](packages/cipher/llm/llms.txt) — Engineering tooling. Dark-first, Inter + JetBrains Mono, syntax-highlighting palette.

## Per-variant LLM artifacts

Each variant ships a complete LLM-readable layer at `packages/<variant>/llm/`:

- `tokens.json` — DTCG-format design tokens (source of truth)
- `principles.md` — visual character, do/don't, when to choose
- `content.md` — voice and microcopy patterns
- `motion.md` — motion personality and reduced-motion behavior
- `i18n.md` — locale fitness and RTL guidance
- `starter-prompt.md` — drop-in starter prompt for any LLM
- `components.json` — schema-validated component manifest
- `llms.txt` — concise machine-readable summary

## Tooling

- **MCP server**: `packages/mcp/` — local stdio + remote HTTP transports
- **Figma Code Connect**: `figma/code-connect/` — design-to-code mappings (deferred until variants ship components)
- **Showcase site**: `apps/showcase/` — Next.js documentation and template renderer
- **Storybook (secondary)**: `apps/storybook/` — raw component exploration (deferred)

## Foundation

Built on IBM Carbon Design System (Apache 2.0). Variants override Carbon's design tokens to express alternative visual identities. Component machinery, accessibility, RTL, motion, density, and i18n are inherited from Carbon.
